=== Possible Thomas Glasgow, Kentucky postal addressee, 1799 ===
Thomas Glasgow, Kentucky, is named in a list of letters remaining at the Lexington post office, printed 24 January 1799.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/1181678638/ Kentucky Gazette, 1799-01-24, p.3].</ref>

Kentucky is the printed qualifier. The postal list gives no age, occupation, family or evidence of continuous residence.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1620]]. Recorded exact 8 September 1761 Currie birth permits adulthood; estimated c.1834 Midlothian death is not exact, and no Kentucky connection is supplied.
